name: ESP32-family chip-specific QA benchmark
description: Chip-specific questions with exact answers taken from the official documentation in the knowledge base. Extend this file to 100-150 items by appending objects with the same fields.

schema.category: free-form topic label used for per-category breakdowns
schema.question: the question, written without the chip name (the chip comes from the selector)
schema.answers: list of accepted answer strings; a prediction matches if it contains any one of them
schema.all_of: optional list of strings that must ALL appear in the prediction (for multi-part answers); when present it replaces `answers` for Exact Match
schema.source_chunk_id: id of the knowledge-base chunk that contains the answer
